sentences.text: I t is submitted by learned counsel appearing for appellant that appellant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix was known to Safiq Khan since last one year.
Appellant has not committed any offence.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge-sheet has already been filed.
In these circumstances, appellant be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned Government Advocate appearing for State as well as counsel appearing for objector opposed the criminal appeal for grant of bail and read over the FIR.
As per FIR, Safiq Khan took prosecturix along with him in a car.
Later on, appellant joined him and offered her drinks laced with drugs, she became partly unconscious and thereafter she was raped.
There is allegation of gang rape and offence is serious in nature.
In these circumstances, criminal appeal be dismissed.

5. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
6.
Considering facts and circumstances of the case, criminal appeal filed by appellant is dismissed.
7. Appellant is at liberty to file repeat criminal appeal after examination of prosecutrix in Court.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
